title: Abduction and implant prevalence estimates

tellings.quote: Well, the people that they implant uh they they've they've abducted about 3% of the American population according to Dr. L.

plain: About 3% of all Americans are said to have been taken by aliens, some of them left with implants in their bodies. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants, gives this figure, passing on the estimate of a doctor named Roger Leir who worked with him. If true, it would mean millions of people have been abducted.
